alt: An unedited 1-minute video demonstrating a total, system-wide carrier-level shutdown of John Wesley Health Centers (JWCH). Outbound calls on speakerphone to three primary JWCH numbers (toll-free central line, regional line, and Palmdale local clinic line) all fail with Verizon's 'Announcement 3' (Suspended) and 'Announcement 4' (Disconnected) intercept messages. A final call to a national Rickroll hotline connects instantly, proving the caller's outbound service is fully active and healthy.

full_text:
Video Transcript:
0:00 - Phone screen displays caller logs.
0:03 - Dialing JWCH Central Toll-Free line (1-866-733-5924) on speakerphone.
0:05 - Connection established. Verizon automated voice intercept plays: 'We're unable to complete your call. To speak to a customer service representative, please hang up and dial Star-6-1-1. Announcement 3.'
0:14 - Hangs up.
0:18 - Dialing JWCH Regional main line (1-562-867-7999) on speakerphone.
0:21 - Connection established. Verizon automated voice intercept plays: 'We're unable to complete your call. To speak to a customer service representative, please hang up and dial Star-6-1-1. Announcement 3.'
0:31 - Hangs up.
0:38 - Dialing JWCH Palmdale Central local clinic line (1-661-942-2391) on speakerphone.
0:41 - Connection established. Verizon automated voice intercept plays: 'Your call cannot be completed as dialed. Please check the number and dial again. Announcement 4.'
0:47 - Hangs up.
0:52 - Dialing national Rickroll hotline (1-248-434-5508) on speakerphone.
0:54 - Connection established instantly. High-quality music plays: 'Never Gonna Give You Up' by Rick Astley.
1:06 - Hangs up. End of video.
